experience_year_policy.2_to_3: MANUAL_REVIEW unless graduate/equivalent wording or strong evidence resolves eligibility
experience_year_policy.3_plus: MANUAL_REVIEW by default; FAIL only when clearly mandatory and incompatible

criticality.unknown_behavior: MANUAL_REVIEW when the independent hard-filter policy requires evidence; never trigger the circuit breaker from UNKNOWN alone

ambiguity_policy: Use MANUAL_REVIEW, never FAIL, when a true eligibility condition cannot be established from available text.
